dispositions.reason: Reached only from a favorite's repeat surface; this lane restarts from History. The panel's four states are proved in src/ui/favorite-progression.test.tsx and src/app/ReviewRoute.test.tsx.
Review renders no swap control in the current source; Swap lives on the Workout exercise card and is pictured there (active-standard-superset-circuit, variant swap-options).
As swap-confirmation; the swap list's failure state is proved in src/ui/exercise-swap.test.tsx and e2e/d6-swap-persistence.spec.ts.
No generic pause exists in the product: the rest is extended (Add 30s) or skipped, and timed blocks start and finish. "Paused" is pictured as the clock held at exact points, not as a pause control.

observations.text: Coaching: cues, regression and the note field are ruled sub-groups with their labels inside one card, never a card in a card.
Finish workout stays inside the 390x320 short viewport on the last section (TASK-040's recorded overflow condition, now executed).
Review: overview metrics and seven section cards, no card nested in another, every field and label inside its card, Start and Regenerate pinned in the footer.
Standard: shell, section, block and set form are sibling cards; fields and labels inside; Session time is a labelled non-live timer card.
Summary: Duration and Streak are each their own small card; the mood choice and notes share one debrief card with their labels inside; Save and close is pinned in the footer outside the scroller.
A failed Start leaves the briefing in place behind its blocking dialog, with Start offered again; no session was started.
A failed completion keeps the session active behind its dialog; Finish again completes the stored session and lands on Summary.

A real completed fixture with no location follows History Restart into Review; confirmed Regenerate routes to the existing Generate form without a provider request. No route, persistence or generation code changed.
A set whose writes fail stays on the device with one factual notice; Try now sends the same set and the database then holds exactly one row.
Regenerate asks first; confirming discards the briefing and runs a generation (held locally, never forwarded); Cancel returns to Review with nothing to review rather than the discarded workout.
Save writes mood 5 (Peak) and the notes to the completed session row and returns Home; reopening Summary reads the same stored debrief. A failed save keeps the draft.
Start persists and starts the restarted session and lands on /workout with the first set form.

The favorite was saved through the actual Summary action; its real progression read is held/fails on one boundary, retries to the actual first completion (confirmed by its stored counter), and never blocks Start or dispatches generation.

Worn/Flat/Ready/Peak draw the public Frown/Meh/Smile/SmilePlus exactly (mouth path read from the vendored icons.tsx); SmilePlus is one wide smile with no plus; no app source defines a face of its own.

A completed persisted fixture with one weighted working set; anchors are the app's own deriveAnchors over the real anchor_evidence read, stored through set_load_anchors. Review is reached through History Restart, not a sample screen.
A persisted seven-structure prescription started through start_session; the clock is Playwright's, advanced and paused so urgency and timing are observed at exact points.
Additive original width/skin coverage, not a new all-state Cartesian target; original records and runtime are unchanged.
Mood is a radio group: arrow keys move focus, Space selects, keyboard focus is visible, and the selected face carries a tick as well as a tint.
The load suggestion is the public TextAction: a real button with the chevron, a 40px target, reached by Tab with keyboard focus and opening its dialog on Enter.

observations.text: Coaching loading beside an urgent rest: the rest pulse holds the one interface loop and the loading region is stilled but still busy.
Under reduced motion the urgent rest keeps its words, digits and low colours; the pulse and every other animation stop.
EMOM low state: the shipped TimerDisplay is its own card beside the block card, steps its colour over 0.4s and pulses to 80% on the one loop, with no extra glow.
Paused at two clock points six seconds apart, Session time advanced by six and the rest counted down by six: one wall clock drives both.
Rest low state: the card takes the timer-low role, digits cross colour over 0.4s in four steps, the card dims to 80% on the 4s two-step pulse, and no glow is added to the timer.
